0: Establishing a link to our agent turned out to be much more difficult thanks to the Miniknogs. This will require an upgrade to our systems, and for that, our Engineers need a rare component - an ^orange;Alien Broadcast Node^reset;. One such Node belongs the ^green;Froggs in the deep jungle^reset;, but we have no coordinates. You have to find a map to their base.
1: Our agent shared intel. According to that, we need to hack into the network of the Miniknog's Defense System. We need to get ^orange;their A.I. Chip^reset; for that. This chip can be extracted from one of their robots, called ^red;Fatal Circuit^reset;. These are usually stationed on ^green;Cyberspheres^reset;. Keep your eyes open for a pyramid-like laboratory. Good luck, dear.
2: Urgent news! Our agent discovered the location of the ^orange;Apex artifact^reset; - ^green;Miniknog stronghold^reset;. But we need to shutdown Miniknog's Defense Systems if we want to get there in one piece. We already started the process using the chip you provided, but we need a more advanced tool to speed the process up: A ^orange;Research Mainframe^reset;. Could you help?
3: Well, the Baron asked for something... special: an ^orange;Ancient Texts^reset;, somewhere, somehow. I guess these texts are related to the ^green;Darkness^reset;. Why does the Baron need it? Regardless, this is our only chance to get the ^orange;artifact^reset;. This might require a deep dive into ^green;Metaphysics research^reset;.
4: To control and stabilize each artifact using the ^orange;Ancient Remote^reset; we need an equally powerful energy source. Our engineers considered using ^orange;8 Anulax Batteries^reset; in total. The secrets to making those is lost precursor technology, so creating them is out of the question. Look around ^green;Cyberspheres for Precursor structures^reset;.
5: There we go. The machine to negate pathogenic influence of ^red; The Ruins^reset; is ready. It will protect you as long as you are there, no matter where or how deep you will go. Yet, it still requires ^orange;powerful fuel^reset; to work. Could you gather ^orange;10 Ultronium Rods^reset; for that, please?
